alternatives.description: Leave daily candidate materialization manual and unowned by a deterministic governed tool.
alternatives.projected_effect: No new candidate writer exists, but daily archive/version rules remain dependent on manual execution.
alternatives.risk: Candidate lineage and once-per-day checks can drift across manual runs.

alternatives.description: Stage a deterministic candidate-only materializer that validates admitted-delta quorum and predecessor identity before writing successor files.
alternatives.projected_effect: A complete five-file candidate can be materialized at most through explicit invocation while canonical/current remains untouched.
alternatives.risk: The tool itself must remain review-gated and cannot be mistaken for canonical promotion authority.

bidirectional_gaps.gap: DO_NOTHING lacks deterministic candidate lineage/archive enforcement.
The candidate tool adds code and file-writing capability that must remain behind review, ActionGate and human canonical-promotion boundaries.

assumptions: Garden v15.5 remains immutable and canonical/current is never written by this tool.
Every admitted delta must already carry >=3 blind reviewer families, >=3 peer-final families and GSL admission PASS.
This proposal is not merge-ready until required independent repo-design review completes.
reason.uncertainty: Private multi-review quorum is not yet available and full daily end-to-end materialization has not been admitted; the candidate remains draft.
counterexamples: A manifest with fewer than three independent reviewer families must be rejected.
A candidate version not greater than its immediate predecessor must be rejected.
Materialization must not alter canonical/current or grant canonical promotion authority.
reason.conclusion: Keep the daily materializer as a candidate-only proposal, run CI and governed ActionGate for PROPOSE, and do not merge or materialize a semantic successor until the independent-review requirement is satisfied.

obligations.statement: The materializer rejects insufficient independent or peer-review quorum and non-PASS GSL admission.
The materializer preserves canonical/current and writes successor candidates only under explicit apply.
The materializer archives any previous candidate with predecessor/source-root lineage and appends version history.
The repository change passes reasoning, algebra, AAP, trusted governance and ActionGate without expanding authority.

items.claim_scope: Requires at most one daily successor candidate after multi-review and GSL admission while canonical promotion remains human-only.
Immutable predecessor for this repository candidate.
The first draft run passed 112 deterministic implementation tests but failed closed before ActionGate because governed production receipts were absent.
